values.name: relates-to
values.definition: Generic association between two concepts (symmetric; its own inverse).

values.name: part-of
values.definition: The containing concept is a component or member of the target (composition/containment).

values.name: has-part
values.definition: Inverse of part-of: the containing concept contains the target as a component or member.

values.name: depends-on
values.definition: The containing concept requires the target to function.

values.name: depended-on-by
values.definition: Inverse of depends-on: the target requires the containing concept to function.

values.name: references
values.definition: The containing concept cites or points at the target.

values.name: referenced-by
values.definition: Inverse of references: the target cites or points at the containing concept.

values.name: derived-from
values.definition: The containing concept was produced from the target.

values.name: source-of
values.definition: Inverse of derived-from: the containing concept was used to produce the target.

values.name: supersedes
values.definition: The containing concept replaces the target; the target is deprecated.

values.name: superseded-by
values.definition: Inverse of supersedes: the containing concept has been replaced by the target.

values.name: contradicts
values.definition: Known conflict with the target (symmetric; its own inverse). Carries an open/resolved lifecycle (SPEC §6.5).

values.name: supports
values.definition: The containing concept is evidence for the target. The counterpart to contradicts.

values.name: supported-by
values.definition: Inverse of supports: the target is evidence for the containing concept.

values.name: merged-into
values.definition: The containing concept was absorbed by the target and is now a tombstone.

values.name: merged-from
values.definition: Inverse of merged-into: the containing concept absorbed the target, which is now a tombstone.

values.name: split-from
values.definition: The containing concept was carved out of the target.

values.name: split-into
values.definition: Inverse of split-from: the target was carved out of the containing concept.

values.name: authored-by
values.definition: Attribution: the containing concept was authored by the target (typically a Person).

values.name: author-of
values.definition: Inverse of authored-by: the containing concept (typically a Person) authored the target.

values.name: describes
values.definition: The containing concept explains or documents the target.

values.name: described-by
values.definition: Inverse of describes: the containing concept is explained or documented by the target.

values.name: depicts
values.definition: Registered extension rel: a visual asset shows the target.

values.name: depicted-in
values.definition: Inverse of depicts: the containing concept is shown in the target visual asset.

values.name: remediates
values.definition: Registered extension rel: a runbook or fix addresses a problem in the target.

values.name: remediated-by
values.definition: Inverse of remediates: the containing concept's problem is addressed by the target runbook or fix.

values.name: discusses
values.definition: Registered extension rel: a recording or thread covers the target.

values.name: discussed-in
values.definition: Inverse of discusses: the containing concept is covered in the target recording or thread.
